tools.name: communico_list_events
tools.description: List library events between two dates (Attend). Filter by status, location, room, type, age group, tags or a search term. Returns { total, start, limit, entries }.

tools.name: communico_get_event
tools.description: Get one event by its eventId (Attend).

tools.name: communico_get_event_series
tools.description: List the events of one recurring series by its recurringId (Attend).

tools.name: communico_list_event_registrants
tools.description: List the registrants of one event (names, emails, phone numbers and library card fields of the people who signed up). Personal data: use only for the library's own event administration.

tools.name: communico_find_patron_registrations
tools.description: List the event registrations of one library patron, found by barcode (Attend). Personal data: use only for the library's own patron service.

tools.name: communico_list_event_ages
tools.description: List the age group names used on events (Attend).

tools.name: communico_list_event_types
tools.description: List the event type names used on events (Attend).

tools.name: communico_list_locations
tools.description: List the library locations (branches) of this client. Returns { total, start, limit, entries }.

tools.name: communico_get_location
tools.description: Get one library location by its id.

tools.name: communico_list_rooms
tools.description: List the bookable rooms, optionally for one location (Reserve).

tools.name: communico_list_reservations
tools.description: List room reservations between two dates, with optional location, room and status filters (Reserve).

tools.name: communico_get_reservation
tools.description: Get one room reservation by its reservationId (Reserve).

tools.name: communico_list_appointment_categories
tools.description: List the appointment categories, groups and assets of the authenticated library system (Schedule).

tools.name: communico_list_appointments
tools.description: List booked appointments, with optional category, group, asset, date range and status filters (Schedule).

tools.name: communico_get_appointment
tools.description: Get one booked appointment by its appointmentId (Schedule).
